messages.author: 99540594784b9805
messages.subject: Re: Peptide Level Comparison
parts:
Here's one way you could do this:
1. Install MSstats external tool in Skyline
2. Import the attached .skyr file into Skyline using:
File > Export > Report > Import...
3. Change the definition for the Group comparison menu item by going to:
Tools > External Tools
and changing the "Input Report" for the "Group Comparison" item from "MSstats Input" to "PeptideLevelMSstatsInput".

If you want to go back to doing protein level comparisons with the tool in Skyline then you can change that Input Report back to "MSstats Input".
